description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once the holder is hit, this item will burst.
name: Air Balloon
shortDescription: Holder is immune to Ground-type attacks. Pops when holder is hit.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This offensive vest raises Sp. Def but prevents the use of status moves.
name: Assault Vest
shortDescription: Holder's Sp. Def is 1.5×, but it can only select damaging moves.

name: Booster Energy
shortDescription: Activates the Protosynthesis or Quark Drive Abilities. Single use.

description: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Charizard hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
name: Charizardite X
shortDescription: If held by a Charizard, this item allows it to Mega Evolve into Mega Charizard X.

description: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Charizard hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
name: Charizardite Y
shortDescription: If held by a Charizard, this item allows it to Mega Evolve into Mega Charizard Y.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious headband boosts Attack but only allows the use of one move.
name: Choice Band
shortDescription: Holder's Attack is 1.5×, but it can only select the first move it executes.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts Speed but only allows the use of one move.
name: Choice Scarf
shortDescription: Holder's Speed is 1.5×, but it can only select the first move it executes.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These curious glasses boost Sp. Atk but only allow the use of one move.
name: Choice Specs
shortDescription: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5×, but it can only select the first move it executes.

name: Cornerstone Mask
shortDescription: Ogerpon-Cornerstone: 1.2× power attacks; Terastallize to gain Embody Aspect.

description: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held by a Pokémon that can still evolve, it raises both Defense and Sp. Def.
name: Eviolite
shortDescription: If holder's species can evolve, its Defense and Sp. Def are 1.5×.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.
name: Expert Belt
shortDescription: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2× damage.

description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. The stone has a fiery orange heart.
name: Fire Stone
shortDescription: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP, it will endure a potential KO attack with 1 HP. The item then disappears.
name: Focus Sash
shortDescription: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

description: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Garchomp hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
name: Garchompite
shortDescription: If held by a Garchomp, this item allows it to Mega Evolve into Mega Garchomp.

description: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Gengar hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
name: Gengarite
shortDescription: If held by a Gengar, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.

name: Hearthflame Mask
shortDescription: Ogerpon-Hearthflame: 1.2× power attacks; Terastallize to gain Embody Aspect.

description: These boots prevent the effects of traps set on the battlefield.
name: Heavy-Duty Boots
shortDescription: When switching in, the holder is unaffected by hazards on its side of the field.

description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.
name: Ice Stone
shortDescription: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.

description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern.
name: Leaf Stone
shortDescription: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is slowly but steadily restored throughout every battle.
name: Leftovers
shortDescription: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves but at the cost of some HP on each hit.
name: Life Orb
shortDescription: Holder's attacks do 1.3× damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

description: An item to be held by Pikachu. It’s a puzzling orb that boosts its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
name: Light Ball
shortDescription: If held by a Pikachu, its Attack and Sp. Atk are doubled.

description: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Lucario hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
name: Lucarionite
shortDescription: If held by a Lucario, this item allows it to Mega Evolve into Mega Lucario in battle.

description: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from any status condition during battle.
name: Lum Berry
shortDescription: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.
name: Rocky Helmet
shortDescription: If holder is hit by a contact move, the attacker loses 1/6 of its max HP.

description: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can restore its own HP by a small amount during battle.
name: Sitrus Berry
shortDescription: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a distinct thunderbolt pattern.
name: Thunder Stone
shortDescription: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.

description: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Venusaur hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
name: Venusaurite
shortDescription: If held by a Venusaur, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.

description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is the blue of a pool of clear water.
name: Water Stone
shortDescription: Evolves certain species of Pokemon when used.
